scope: 18 private proofs and existing target; mathematical/source/contract review, not fresh native execution

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_full_embed
chunks.review: The full-bank identity consumes the public embedEmitCfg_eq reconstruction contract. The range/frame side conditions are elementary consumer layout glue; the older private b2b_embed_refl and unapproved requested public reader do not supply a missing shipped prerequisite.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_seam
chunks.review: Current0d directly cites public seamCompTM_step with its exact run, endpoint-control and first-return-cut premises. The old tuple reconstruction is gone; complete private header is unchanged.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_native_halt
chunks.review: Chooses the fixed startup before code, then each code-only startup time before suffix. The explicitly authorized stationary silent leaf halts in one step; seam dispatch adds one, giving T+2. Published endpoint/liveness equations supply exact bank/input/head/output fields and strict first halt.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_header
chunks.review: Applies headerRulerTM_run at physical offset0 to pairEncode u v and blank last ruler. The budget header length is2|u|+2, endpoint input isℓ+1, all heads0 and non-ruler tapes blank. No numerical budget interpretation is introduced.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_mapState_mk
chunks.review: Literal relabelling uses public Cfg.mapState_eq_of_fields; it is small technical field glue, with no foreign definition explicitly unfolded.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_hosted
chunks.review: The premise is genuinely first-halting at none. H5 supplies the hosted endpoint and earlier-none liveness; embedEmitRetTM_run turns that first halt into a live anchor cut. Tagfalse is justified by initial virtual input position1. The complete bank is last-ruler presentation, not arbitrary scratch.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_ruler_moves
chunks.review: Published skip/walk/rewind contracts give the third/fourth/sixth phases atℓ1+1,1,andN+2. The empty-word left walk corrects the skip’s blank overshoot. Bank/input/output stay fixed; last-ruler head endpoints areℓ1+1,ℓ1,0.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_scan
chunks.review: The general headerScanTM_run is used on the nonblank existing ruler; headerScanCfg_ruler extends true^ℓ1 to true^(ℓ1+ℓ2). Field equations preserve all other bank tapes and output, and advance physical input byℓ2.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_prefix
chunks.review: Actually constructs all six fixed phases and five seams beforeα. Every live first-return cut is passed through the public seam contract. Installed table/state bank, all heads0, empty output and inputℓ+1 are explicit. The phase-time sum is bounded by CH(ℓ+1)(Tα+2)+4ℓ+11, with code-only Tα.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_loop
chunks.review: The fixed three-tape forwarding loop is embedded into the whole K+3 bank and hosted with the ruler last. forwardLoop_forward supplies first source halt≤t and the complete later endpoint, including arbitrary output. The published visitedByTapeHead_mono replaces the earlier inline re-derivation. Mirror, both auxiliaries, every idle singleton and ruler are handled separately.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_last_ruler_layout
chunks.review: Reconciles complete configurations through embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init and rulerHostCfg field equations. The equality contains bank order, tape contents, all heads, physical input, output and injected state; it is stronger than tape-count agreement.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_cast_init_run
chunks.review: Equality induction transports the initialized run along the tape-count equality. No new interface, runtime data or foreign-definition simp/unfold argument.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_cast_init_space
chunks.review: Equality induction transports initialized work-space. This is a proof-local dependent transport, preserving the frozen target and model measure.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_cast_cfg_state
chunks.review: Equality induction preserves configuration control under the tape-count transport.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_cast_cfg_mapState
chunks.review: Equality induction commutes with relabelling; the helper changes no machine or public contract.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_cast_cfg_embedding
chunks.review: After equality induction the transport is exactly the full-bank identity embedding, discharged through f6_full_embed.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_cast_back_embedding
chunks.review: After equality induction the inverse transported full-bank embedding is the original configuration, again through f6_full_embed.

chunks.name: Complexity.f6_final_seam
chunks.review: The zero-outer startupLoopTM contracts receive actual prefix run/cut/exit, complete endpoint equality, prefix-space bound and every per-tape loop bound. Dispatch adds1; space is B+(K+4)S. No conditional OWN premise survives undischarged in the final target.

chunks.name: Complexity.space_universal
chunks.review: SU is chosen before everyα; positive Cα followsα but precedes s,x,output,t. Public CodeTM.toFinTM_eq and computesInTime_iff expose the exact one-tape source. CodeTM.one_le_spaceUsed forces s≥1 for qualifying runs. Actual prefix/loop witnesses close halt, full arbitrary output and Cα*s with no input-length addend.
